summary: Sandbach United are just one week away from kicking off their 2026/27 campaign, and the Ramblers are gearing up with three brand new kits and some exciting new signings plus a returning player to bolster the squad. Fresh off a narrow loss to St Helens in what was described as a tight, competitive match, the club is now looking for sponsorship partners to support their promotion push. With player details being released ahead of the big kick-off, there's plenty of optimism around Sandbach as they prepare for what promises to be an ambitious season.
